summary: Iteration 5 — all four features verified end-to-end. 18/18 pytest tests pass in ~9s plus Playwright UI verification of /install and /jobs. (1) Existing-web-panel installer: /install page renders host-picker with 5 modes (standalone/cpanel/plesk/directadmin/nginx), radio switches live-update the [data-testid=install-cmd] one-liner and [data-testid=reverse-proxy-snippet] block — verified standalone→cpanel→nginx transitions produce correct ProxyPass/proxy_pass blocks with the chosen port. /install.sh serves 200 and contains all 5 coexist branches + 127.0.0.1 loopback bind for coexist modes. settings table has panel_port/coexist_mode/panel_url_path rows seeded by schema_v5. (2) Real loader runtimes: runtime.py imports and runs; resolve() with loader slug='paper' downloaded a real Paper 1.20.4 JAR (~50MB range) into the tmp work_dir, wrote eula.txt (eula=true), and returned the expected `java -Xms256M -XmxNM -jar server.jar nogui` command. Non-Java game (cs2) falls back to fake_game.py. Paper CDN worked in this sandbox — no 403 encountered. (3) Job cancellation: created a real modpack_install job via daemon, POSTed /api/daemon/jobs/{id}/cancel, worker stopped between chunks, jobs.status transitioned to 'cancelled' within 30s, servers.modpack_status rolled back to 'none'. Edge cases verified: cancel on completed job → 200 {already_finished:true}, cancel on nonexistent job → 404. /jobs page renders [data-testid=cancel-job-{id}] form only for queued/running rows and hides it for terminal statuses (verified visually — 3 CANCELLED pills render with no cancel button). (4) Concurrency guard: two rapid POSTs to /api/daemon/modpack/install-async/{sid} return the same job_id with second response containing {already_running:true, status:'running'} — DB count confirmed exactly 1 modpack_install row for that sid. Regression: /dashboard, /servers, /jobs, /mods, /eggs, /install all 200; Modrinth preview for fabulously-optimized still returns {ok:true, data:{title:...}}. Login flow uses `email` field (not `username`).
critical_code_review_comments: runtime.py's _download() writes the whole response into memory-then-disk via shutil.copyfileobj — that's fine, but there is no size cap or SHA verification. A malicious/hijacked PaperMC mirror could push a rogue JAR. Consider using the SHA256 field the Paper v3 API returns (build.downloads['server:default'].checksums.sha256) and verifying after download.

runtime.resolve() catches nothing and lets urllib.URLError bubble up; the caller daemon.build_start_cmd catches Exception and logs '[runtime] bootstrap failed' but the server is still marked whatever status the /action call set it to — it never rolls status back to 'crashed' on runtime bootstrap failure. If Paper CDN is down for real, the panel silently starts fake_game.py instead of surfacing that the requested loader could not be provisioned.

Concurrency-guard SELECT in modpack_install_async is not transactional — two concurrent POSTs at the same millisecond could both see zero existing rows and both create a job (TOCTOU). Use `FOR UPDATE` inside a transaction, or add a unique partial index on jobs(target_id, kind) WHERE status IN ('queued','running') via a trigger. In practice the FastAPI single-worker + GIL make this unlikely, but it's worth noting.

cancel_job endpoint has no auth check on the daemon side — anyone with network access to 127.0.0.1:8001 can cancel any job by id. The PHP Jobs::cancel proxies through require_role('operator') so the public path is safe, but if the daemon port is ever exposed (docker port mapping mistake) it becomes an open API. Add a shared-secret header check like the rest of /api/daemon/* endpoints (which currently also have none — same issue).

install.sh copies `./*` into /opt/apexnode without excluding .git, storage/, or the panel's own log dirs — a first-time install pulled from a curl-piped tarball won't have those, but a `git clone && cd panel && ./install/install.sh` will drag ~all committed state in. Consider using rsync with --exclude patterns, or ship a proper release tarball.

install.sh does not restart php-fpm after writing config/.env, so if the socket is under a version that changes between apt runs the panel could 502. Add `systemctl reload php*-fpm` after the ENV write.

install.sh runs `pip3 install --quiet -r ...requirements.txt || true` — silently swallows failures. If the daemon deps don't install, apex-daemon starts and immediately crashes with ImportError; the operator sees only 'Done!'. Drop the `|| true` or capture and echo the exit code.

jobs/index.php live poller updates the status pill but never adds/removes the cancel form — after a cancel completes the button stays visible until manual reload. Minor UX polish: also update the row's actions cell in the setInterval loop.

views/jobs/index.php status class map now includes 'cancelled'=>'offline' but there's no dedicated CSS class for it — cancelled jobs look identical to failed. Consider a distinct status-cancelled CSS class (grey/muted).

runtime.PAPER_VERSION is hardcoded to 1.20.4 — no way to pick a Minecraft version per server. The panel's server row already carries a `minecraft_version` column in older iterations; wire it through if available, or expose a dropdown when loader=paper.

schema_v5.sql uses `IF NOT EXISTS` on ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN — great for reruns, but MariaDB < 10.0 doesn't support it. Since your installer targets Debian 12 (MariaDB 10.11) this is fine; just document the min version.
